coverage.note: Calendar range is an envelope, not a claim that every route runs every day. Exceptions applied. Saturday Sep26 chosen because Sep12 and Sep19 have special LRT timetables. Tuesday Sep15 and Sunday Sep20 are explicit reference dates, not predictions.

metadata.kindNote: kind=transit preserves existing map-filter compatibility. transitMode contains bus or train, determined from served GTFS route_type.
metadata.scope: All 6,214 source GTFS stops; route associations span the feed and do not mean live service or boarding at every stop/time. Use the detailed transit access dataset for reference-date boarding service.
